title: P2 connection.register: request
description: The consent adapter registers a connection after the person granted access at the provider (SEC-7). The request presents the link nonce that the core issued at /mydata connect (single use, 10 minutes, bound to the tenant and the principal); the core takes the principal from the nonce, not from the adapter or the body. The core refuses an external account that another principal has connected (connection_account_taken), generates token_ref itself and writes the connection as pending until the person confirms the connection_confirm card. The answer names token_ref, under which the adapter stores the token.

link_nonce.description: The single-use nonce of the link that the core issued at /mydata connect.

account_id.description: The external account: the subject id that the provider returned with the token; shown to the person on the connection_confirm card.
